title: The Immortal Jellyfish: Nature’s Reset Button
hook: What if aging could be undone at will?
script: What if aging could be undone at will? The Turritopsis dohrnii jellyfish can reverse its own life cycle. When injured or old, it reverts to its juvenile polyp form. This astonishing capability allows it to start anew, potentially forever. In just 24 hours, it can transform back to its younger state after stress. This challenges our understanding of aging as a linear process. The jellyfish's ability stems from transdifferentiation, a remarkable cellular transformation. Just 4.5 millimeters in diameter, it is the only known animal that is biologically immortal.
